summary: Ubisoft's non-Monster Jam Monster 4x4 sequels, beginning after the licensed Masters of Metal entry and covering arcade monster-truck racing on Xbox, Wii, and Nintendo 3DS.

entries.title: Monster 4x4: World Circuit

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin for upscale-friendly play; use a real Wii if the steering accessory/control feel is the priority.

primary.why: World Circuit released on Xbox and Wii, and the Wii version was a system launch title with the series' dedicated steering-wheel shell support. Dolphin upscaling makes the Wii route the best modern high-fidelity and preservation path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Wii version through Dolphin with internal resolution upscaling; use original Wii hardware and the steering-wheel shell if preserving the launch-control feel matters.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition. Masters of Metal remains cataloged under Monster Jam because it uses that license; World Circuit drops it.

entries.title: Monster 4x4: Stunt Racer

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin for upscaled fidelity or original Wii hardware for native motion controls.

primary.why: Stunt Racer was released exclusively on Wii and emphasizes agile stunt-track design such as nitro-powered wall driving; it is the only complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Wii version through Dolphin with internal resolution upscaling, or on original Wii hardware for native controls.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.

entries.title: Monster 4x4 3D

emulation.notes: Use original 3DS hardware for the intended stereoscopic effect; use emulator upscaling for capture or high-resolution preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: 3DS emulation can improve resolution, but original hardware preserves stereoscopy

primary.why: Monster 4x4 3D was released exclusively for Nintendo 3DS and was built around the handheld's stereoscopic 3D display, making the 3DS release the only complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original 3DS hardware for the stereoscopic 3D presentation, or use Citra/Lime3DS for preservation and higher-resolution output without the original screen effect.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.
